result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: Customer may terminate for convenience on 30 days’ written notice, receives a pro-rata refund of prepaid fees for the post-termination period, and owes no early-termination penalty. Vendor is expressly denied a termination-for-convenience right during a term. The addition is targeted, does not disturb the existing cause-based or Order Form termination provisions, and is professionally drafted. Adding a section number would improve formatting but is not a substantive defect.
